title: POST /v1/gateway-deployments request body (as-built)
description: organization_id and project_id are the only hard-required keys (KeyError -> 500 today if missing). mode defaults to the deployment model's gateway_mode or 'self_hosted'. : gateway deployments carry no fee, so creation never charges the wallet (the legacy charge_wallet flag was removed with the component price book).

deployment_model_id.description: Optional. Resolved by resolve_deployment_model. The fully_self_hosted_byo_provider option was removed.

carrier_account_id.description: Defaults to the deployment model's carrier account or 'managed_didww_resale'. Known values: sandbox_fake_provider, managed_didww_resale, byo_didww_account, self_managed_provider.

provider.description: Provider key for the auto-attached provider account; defaults to 'didww'.

provider_account_id.description: Attach an existing provider account instead of auto-creating one.
